newsitem.title: USA: Bausch & Lomb sees $0.11/shr loss on sale.
newsitem.headline: Bausch & Lomb sees $0.11/shr loss on sale.

text.p: Bausch & Lomb Inc said on Monday it expected to take a $6.3 million or $0.11 per share charge in the third quarter from the sale of its Oral Care division to privately-held personal care appliance manufacturer CONAIR of East Windsor, N.J.
The company said in a statement it had completed the sale, part of its strategy to focus on its core eye care business.

"The sale of Oral Care business allows Bausch & Lomb to better concentrate on building our global eye care business and bringing more innovative eye care products to the market place to meet the needs of the consumer," Chairman and Chief Executive Officer William Waltrip said in a statement.
The company said in January it would sell the division and terms were not disclosed.
The division accounted for less than three percent of total company revenues, Bausch & Lomb said.
